text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Furioso crosses the finish line first!!
She did it! A GⅠ victory on her home turf—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
At the reopened Funabashi, a Funabashi Umamusume has won!
âThe signal gun of resurrection echoes now!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A new era has arrived!
It's the dawn of a brand-new era for Funabashi!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
All right! Nice!
Nice, nice, nice!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: It's a victory for Funabashiiii!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: Yaaay, Furipyon!!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Thank you for winning...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheers several times louder than usual.
Striking a fist pump with all her might, Furioso—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carried by my soaring excitement, I rushed into the stands.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
We won't lose!
No matter how great the hardship!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
We won't lose!
No matter how strong the opponent!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I swear upon this victory,
and from here on——)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (We will seize it, our tomorrow...!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Dammit alllll--!!
Don't go losing on me, for crying out loud!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Man, when she runs like that, what can you do?
Truly impressive, Furioso."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the waiting room after the race. I chat happily with Espoir City and Transcend, who came to watch.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, Espo, Tran... We won today
because of the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This spring, we learned
the true dreadfulness of the Central circuit.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—The resolve never to stop running.
And—a glorious triumph on the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because I was inspired by your attitude that I was able to run like I did today.
Isn't that right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing the Central Tracen face national hardship made me straighten my own posture as well.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I believe
I must mend my attitude.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's this? So you've finally given in
and decided to join hands with me?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmm. If the tension's gone and there are no borders between us, then...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Why not just transfer? To the JRA, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her playful invitation caught me off guard for a moment.
However...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, we won't be transferring.
Because we love Funabashi.
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If the Central possesses a radiance called "nobility,"
then Funabashi surely possesses a different kind of brilliance...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"To discover it, nurture it, and build a new Funabashi
standing shoulder-to-shoulder with the Tracen Central."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "That is our goal moving forward. Right, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I want to keep doing that.
Yeah, I hope we can keep doing that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was precisely because we came to understand the Central more deeply that we could search for our future selves. That's how it felt.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well, if you've got no intention of bowing down to me,
then let's do this! I'll crush you thoroughly!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Next race ain't gonna go down like this, though.
It won't be on your home turf, after all.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: You're right... Anywhere other than Funabashi, we can't expect the same home-field advantage and support we had today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most of the cheers today were for Furioso.
However, the only GⅠ held at Funabashi Racecourse is the Kashiwa Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whichever race we choose,
the next one won't be on home turf...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: How about the Teio Sho?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
If you've got the guts, come to the Teio Sho!
I ain't gonna run or hide!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"The Teio Sho..."
That's the GⅠ held at Oi next month in June, right?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's just right around the corner, but...
Trainer, may I accept this?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I don't mind at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Now, the only dirt intermediate GⅠ race remaining in the first half of the year is the Teio Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, the race fatigue doesn't seem too bad either. There shouldn't be any issues.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Espo-san.
Let's settle the score once more at the Teio Sho.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: However—the one who wins will be me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ha, look who's talking!
This time, it's gonna be me!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Umm, excuse me, you two.
Sorry to interrupt while you're having so much fun, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's not guaranteed that the winner
will be one of those two.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Oh, Tran? You runnin' too?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'll pass this time.
However, I do have some exclusive info...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: It seems she's going to run... in the next Teio Sho.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I-It's coming out...!?
Wait, eeeeek... what is!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "No, not a ghost or anything. You know, that horse girl who's been racking up win after win in the regional circuits lately...?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
—Smart Falcon.
Rumor has it that Falco-chan is finally coming to take over.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Falcon-san did...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: In that case, this is our first face-to-face meeting, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah, we can't let our guard down...
Yeah, we can't let our guard down...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An umadol... I am well aware of
how wonderful she is, but I have yet
to face her in an actual race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just what kind of run will this phenomenal front-runner,
known as the "Silence Suzuka of Dirt," show us?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on!
Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Who's gonna win: me, Falco, or Furioso?
Don't you dare run away!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I will not take a single step back.
Trainer, let us prepare—for our decisive battle this spring!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The Teio Sho.
This three-way battle against the two rising stars is shaping up to be the fiercest race yet."
